note: Rendering-medium layer. Orthogonal to the style library (styles.json): any style can be rendered in any medium. 'pairs_well' / 'pairs_badly' are guidance, not hard rules - see references/media-layers.md for how to override.

media.core_en: hand-drawn marker illustration, confident marker linework with visible pen pressure and slightly uneven stroke weight, flat marker fill with subtle overlap strokes, slight paper tooth, scanned-paper texture
media.surface_note: Add stroke overlap and paper tooth; remove digital smoothness.
media.video_note: Sketch-on reveal edit (hand-draws over a static frame) matches the medium natively.
media.common_fail: Marker renders as flat vector unless you explicitly ask for stroke overlap and paper tooth.
media.default_lighting: flat even lighting with no cast shadow, like a scanned drawing

media.core_en: graphite pencil sketch on textured paper, visible pencil grain and tonal hatching, delicate cross-hatching for shadow, construction lines partially visible, soft smudged charcoal tones, no colour
media.surface_note: Reveal construction lines; do not clean up the drawing.
media.video_note: Time-lapse drawing reveal; extremely strong in short-form.
media.common_fail: Without visible hatching the output reads as photoreal, not sketch.
media.default_lighting: soft even lighting with no cast shadow, value read from hatching alone

media.core_en: black ink brush line art on white paper, tapered brush strokes with thick-to-thin variation, confident single-pass drawing, dry-brush texture at stroke ends, no fill, no colour
media.surface_note: Let strokes taper; resist uniform line weight.
media.video_note: Draw-on animation is native; matches stroke order.
media.common_fail: Uniform-width lines kill the hand-drawn read.
media.default_lighting: no lighting at all, pure black line on a flat white ground

media.core_en: watercolour painting, transparent pigment washes, soft wet edges with darker hard edges where the wash dried, visible pigment granulation, colour bleeding and backruns, cold-press paper texture showing through, reserved white paper highlights, three to four pigment palette
media.surface_note: Reserve white; never fill the whole canvas.
media.video_note: Paint-on time-lapse or slow wash-bloom loop.
media.common_fail: Opaque coverage and hard edges make it read as gouache or digital.
media.default_lighting: soft diffuse daylight with no strong cast shadow

media.core_en: flat opaque gouache painting, matte blocky colour fills with visible brush-edge texture, slight value variation within each fill, clean simplified shapes, no gloss, minimal blending
media.surface_note: Keep fills opaque and matte; no transparency.
media.video_note: Flat fills animate cleanly - good for motion graphics.
media.common_fail: Adding gloss or blending turns gouache into digital 2D.
media.default_lighting: flat even lighting with no cast shadow

media.core_en: thick oil impasto painting, heavily loaded palette-knife paint with visible ridges and peaks, sculptural paint handling, rich deep saturated darks, broken colour in the highlights, visible canvas weave texture, single warm key light
media.surface_note: Paint must have physical thickness; ask for ridge highlights.
media.video_note: Slow camera move over a static painting; add parallax to feel alive.
media.common_fail: Flat paint = digital illustration, not oil.
media.default_lighting: single strong warm key light from upper left with a deep cool shadow mass

media.core_en: soft pastel drawing on paper, velvety matte powdery texture, visible chalk grain and directional strokes, gently blended edges with a few hard accents, muted high-key palette, subtle paper tooth showing through
media.surface_note: Powdery matte; avoid gloss and hard digital edges.
media.video_note: Very soft look survives low-quality upscaling well.
media.common_fail: Pastel needs paper tooth to read as real pastel rather than soft digital.
media.default_lighting: soft even diffused lighting with gentle contrast

media.core_en: digital cel shading, clean lineart with two or three flat shading bands, crisp terminator lines between bands, flat saturated local colour, hard-edged shadows, subtle rim light, high-key lighting
media.surface_note: Bands must be discrete; ban gradient shading.
media.video_note: Cleanest style for 2D rig animation and motion graphics.
media.common_fail: Gradient shading destroys the cel read - always name the band count.
media.default_lighting: single hard key from upper left with graphic shadow shapes and a rim light

media.core_en: flat digital vector illustration, pure flat colour fills with no gradients, no texture, consistent line weight, crisp vector-sharp edges, modern editorial illustration, balanced negative space
media.surface_note: Ban gradients, texture and blur entirely.
media.video_note: Shape-morph animation is cheap and seamless here.
media.common_fail: One accidental gradient turns it into generic 2D illustration.
media.default_lighting: flat lighting with no cast shadow

media.core_en: soft matte 3D render, rounded organic volumes, matte dielectric material with subtle subsurface scattering, large soft area key light, gentle rim light, pastel gradient studio backdrop, shallow depth of field
media.surface_note: Materials must be matte with soft falloff, not glossy.
media.video_note: Most robust medium for image-to-video motion.
media.common_fail: Glossy materials turn it into product-render, not character IP.
media.default_lighting: soft large-area key from upper front with a gentle rim light and a pastel gradient backdrop

media.core_en: photorealistic photography of a physical character object, real lens rendering with natural depth of field, accurate materials and surface wear, realistic lighting with practical falloff, shot on a full-frame camera with a fast prime lens
media.surface_note: Keep real wear, dust and imperfection - sterile renders look fake.
media.video_note: Realistic footage style; use real camera moves, not 3D moves.
media.common_fail: Photoreal characters need real-world scale cues or they look like floating dolls.
media.default_lighting: soft large-area key from upper front with a gentle fill and natural background falloff
